subject: health
concept: Understanding how to evaluate the credibility and motives behind media messages related to health and lifestyle
source_inspiration: original content, connecting to Grade 7's health claim evaluation unit — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student matches a described health/lifestyle media message to a likely underlying motive (selling a product, genuine information)
exercise.abstract: Student explains what motive might be behind a described health-related media message

misconception_flags: accepts a media message about health or lifestyle at face value with no consideration of underlying motive

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
